resources.string: Enter YYYY-MM-DD or a relative time such as 1 day, 2 weeks, or 6 months. Relative dates update when you search. YouTube receives after: and before: query terms.
Enter valid dates or relative times, with After earlier than Before.
Order the results collected so far by duration. Unknown durations and live streams appear last and are excluded by duration ranges. Fetch more pages to find additional matches.
Enter valid hours, with Minimum no greater than Maximum.

Collect additional search pages and keep updating the results. You can cancel at any time and keep collected results. The service may not return every matching video. Collection stops at the selected page and result limits, or when no new pages remain. The default result limit is 5,000; you can choose up to 20,000. Fetching again continues with new pages. Requests wait 2 seconds between pages by default. You can change the page count, result limit, and delay, or search a YouTube year month by month.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 250
Enter a delay from 0.3 to 10 seconds
Enter a whole number from 1 to 20,000
Search a year month by month (YouTube)

Monthly collection starts a new result set for the selected year and replaces upload-date filters. The page and result limits apply across all months. You can stop at any time and keep collected results. YouTube may not return every matching video.
